title: Infanticide
summary: INFANT'ICIDE, noun [Low Latin infanticidium; infans, an infant, and coedo, to kill.] 1. The intentional killing of an infant. 2. The slaughter of infants by Herod. Matthew 2:1. 3. A slayer of infants.
